explanation: The English article on the conflict lists Kargil among its wars. In 1999 fighting between the two countries broke out again in Kargil, and it changed nothing on the ground. The article on the war says what set it off. Pakistani troops, disguised as Kashmiri militants, infiltrated positions on the Indian side of the Line of Control, which is the working border in the disputed region of Kashmir. The war is the conflict carried on by other means, and the article treats it as such.
